apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
kind: Scenario
metadata:
  namespace: org.xverse.studio.autoverse
  name: interactive-drive
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Interactive driving with immutable source and a bounded native 
    session.
  provenance:
    source: urn:xverse:studio:autoverse:classic:1.0
    revision: 1.0.0
    maturity: prototype
    limitations:
    - Requires separately installed and admitted native Autoverse services; 
      loading starts nothing.
    - External communication is not native X-COM or a coupled solver; simulation
      time remains unmapped.
spec:
  systemRef:
    apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
    kind: System
    namespace: org.xverse.studio.autoverse
    name: autoverse-demo
  deploymentRef:
    apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
    kind: Deployment
    namespace: org.xverse.studio.autoverse
    name: local-autoverse
  initialConditions:
    driverSurface: studio-browser
    initialBrakingRequest: 1
    initialCruiseRequest: false
    initialReverseRequest: false
    simulatorAdvancement: public-vehicle-cli-synchronous
    fixedDeltaSeconds: 0.05
  steps:
  - id: start-autoverse
    actionKind: start
    targetRef:
      apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
      kind: System
      namespace: org.xverse.studio.autoverse
      name: autoverse-demo
      element: carla
    timeDomainId: host-runtime
    schedule:
      at: 0
      unit: s
    action:
      operation: run-autoverse-classic
  - id: orca-step-1024
    action:
      opaque:
        retained: 1024
      parameter: target
      value: 1
    actionKind: set_parameter
    schedule:
      at: 0
      unit: s
    targetRef:
      apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
      element: carla-node
      kind: System
      name: autoverse-demo
      namespace: org.xverse.studio.autoverse
    timeDomainId: host-runtime
  observers:
  - id: autoverse-telemetry
    targetRef:
      apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
      kind: System
      namespace: org.xverse.studio.autoverse
      name: autoverse-demo
      element: vehicle-spee
